description: This file defines the interface and class structure for the OCDM plugin, including nested classes for notifications and data management, as well as plugin lifecycle methods and JSON-RPC interfaces.

classes.name: OCDM
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing plugin, web, and JSONRPC interfaces, managing plugin lifecycle, notifications, and data.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Nested class handling remote connection notifications, with methods for activation and deactivation events.

classes.name: Data
classes.description: Container class for plugin data, including nested System class for system-specific information.

classes.name: System
classes.description: Represents a system with a name and designators, capable of loading data from a string iterator.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with service configuration.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.
